_purpose: Collector Verification Suite — LCOM4 golden fixtures. ANY implementation (PHP today; Python/Java/Rust tomorrow) must produce identical observations on these examples. Language-neutral by design.
_variant: Hitz & Montazeri LCOM4: connected components over methods; edges = shared instance variable OR intra-class call.

_variant_decisions_pinned.constructors: EXCLUDED (__construct/__destruct) — they touch everything and mask splits
_variant_decisions_pinned.static_methods: INCLUDED as nodes; a static touching no $this is an isolated component (inflates LCOM4 — known, pinned, revisitable)
_variant_decisions_pinned.trait_methods: NOT resolved — only methods declared in the class body are analyzed (known limitation)
_variant_decisions_pinned.inherited_methods: NOT included — the class is analyzed in isolation (known limitation)
_variant_decisions_pinned.magic_methods: no special handling beyond constructor/destructor exclusion

_caution: Validate the metric before validating the code: values on real classes (e.g. Election=29) are observations pending this suite's conformance, never verdicts.
_future_layout: When a second implementation language arrives, this evolves to specification/ + fixtures/ + implementations/{php,python,...} — the specification becomes the source of truth, every implementation executes it. Recorded 2026-08-04; not a refactor instruction.
